what: The first real `redcheck` run misfired twice. A test command passed as one quoted string failed with an empty error, and on a follow-up job the run's base commit already contained the feature, so the check reported green even though the old code on the default branch actually failed most of the new tests.
rule: Pass the test command as separate argv tokens, and check the run's base against the default branch before trusting a green result.
fix: Enforcement: a spawn failure now returns a hint to pass separate argv tokens; `redcheck --base <ref>` restores from an explicit ref, and an omitted `--base` gets a `suggestBase` field and a warning when the run base is not an ancestor of the default branch tip. Documentation: manifest reference.
